create_autoround_compressor: create an AutoRound compressor instance with RTNConfig or SignRoundConfig to quantize a PyTorch model
create_autoround_compatible_wrapper: create an AutoRoundCompatible wrapper for backward-compatible model quantization with the old API using bits and group_size
detect_model_type: detect whether a model is an LLM, MLLM, or Diffusion model using the detect_model_type function
resolve_config_alias: resolve a string config alias like sign_round or rtn to its corresponding config class using AutoRound._resolve_config
check_weight_scheme: check if a quantization scheme is weight-only by calling is_weight_scheme with a scheme string or dict
